name: Sunflower Skies Three-Bracelet Set
materials: Ceramic beads, aquamarine, Czech glass, gold-filled 14/20 beads and components, PVD chain, and gold-plated charms; Carabiner heart clasp
description:
Bring a little sunshine to your wrist with this cheerful three-bracelet set. Sunflower-print ceramic beads, aquamarine, and Czech glass create a bright mix of white, golden yellow, and soft blue. Gold-filled beads and components add a warm finish, while the PVD chain and gold-plated charms bring extra sparkle and personality.

Wear the pieces together for a layered look.
